About

Who We Are

The Real Assets group at the Schulich School of Business, York University, brings together faculty and researchers focused on real property markets, infrastructure finance, housing economics, and related investment and policy questions.

Our work spans both foundational academic research — producing working papers and peer-reviewed publications — and applied research in partnership with public agencies, industry stakeholders, and policy organizations.

We are committed to producing rigorous, relevant research that informs decisions by investors, policymakers, and communities. Our applied projects often translate directly into reports, toolkits, and policy recommendations with real-world impact.
